policy.sourceOfTruth: Authoritative physical altitude and orientation layered over original native horizontal X/Y. Unit3DState publishes immutable canonical gameplay XYZ and velocity snapshots for collision, ramming, explosions, targeting and rendering. Native XY, AI and tile data remain native authority. A controlled-unit provider reads the real FPV FlightController state instead of returning zero altitude. Run after original entity updates with actual simulation seconds; pause freezes altitude integration.
policy.coordinates: Render X=unit.x/tilesize, Z=-unit.y/tilesize. Pose height is body/sprite center in tiles, yaw uses native degrees (0 east/+X,90 north/-Z), positive pitch is nose up and positive roll banks right. Pose is a read-only view updated in place once per simulation update.
policy.flight: Cruise range chosen by native hit size and stable type/id hash; small phase-offset altitude variation. Read sampled terrain under footprint and along predicted native horizontal velocity. Optional mesh bounds add a conservative maximum bank/pitch vertical envelope to clearance. Critically damped bounded-rate climb/descent; native flight velocity supplies travel yaw and bank, so native idle wobble and passive position corrections cannot turn an idle model in circles. Below MIN_TRAVEL_SPEED the model follows native heading and levels pitch/bank. Actual AI controllers, commands, tiny native XY wobble and intentional combat circling remain unchanged. Emergency clearance projection prevents clipping after abrupt terrain changes, teleports or slopes beyond the configured vertical speed; it does not change native X/Y.
policy.passiveSeparation: AltitudeSeparation runs before the pinned v160.5 PhysicsProcess. It retains the original process, refs, registration, collision layers, mass, local-body rule, one-step delayed unit.move and 1.25 softening. While authoritative FPV is active its PhysicsWorld wrappers require physical vertical interval overlap. Flying bodies use the same Unit3DState horizontal radius as ramming, preventing the native 0.6*hitSize circle from pushing apart the 0.5*hitSize shared hulls before contact. Ground bodies and missing XYZ snapshots retain their original native radius. Broad-phase query padding includes the maximum positive physical-radius excess over the native indexed radius in that layer; no native PhysicsBody radius is mutated. Nonoverlapping Z bodies do not push; overlapping Z bodies retain native mass-weighted XY displacement and original AI control. Main-thread immutable body snapshots are published before native layer workers; workers never read live unit/world state. Ramming and impulses are separate unchanged gameplay paths. No new vertical displacement or damage is generated by passive separation.
policy.passiveLifecycle: Reflection is limited to pinned PhysicsProcess physics/refs/futures fields. Before wrapping, unwrapping, world reset or disposal, wait existing native workers. At mode transitions discard the previous uncommitted passive correction so an old 2D correction cannot leak into enabled XYZ mode (or vice versa). An explicit rebase after controlled-pose reset or possession change also discards pending previous-altitude correction and republishes physical snapshots. Original PhysicsWorld instances receive every add/remove and are restored on disable, client network sessions and close; authoritative servers retain XYZ separation. The original process and async registry order otherwise remain intact. Add/remove wait workers before mutating their body lists. Close removes only this adapter. World changes install wrappers around the new native worlds. Snapshot identity is PhysicsBody identity, rebuilt every frame, so pooled unit IDs cannot inherit heights.
policy.ground: GroundSurfaceAdapter derives pitch/roll from local terrain gradient at native heading. A tilted body rests using its actual extrusion half-depth and projected support ring instead of floating at footprint-maximum height on a smooth slope. Discontinuous neighboring cliffs are not mistaken for traversable support under a center that is still on flat ground. Native flyers/boost units descending to ground keep a brief physical landing descent; none acquire native flying status.
policy.lifecycle: Unit reference plus id guards native pool reuse. Replace state on identity change/teleport, prune disappeared/dead/excluded units each update, clear on world reset. Snapshot ground VZ uses actual support-height delta over simulation time; teleport and detected terrain recovery have zero synthetic vertical velocity. Ground support queries return small immutable contact records; immutable XYZ snapshots are allocated only on physical query.
policy.scope: Altitude is shared physical state consumed by new XYZ collision/explosion queries and renderer poses. Covered ordinary projectile, lightning and laser families use this XYZ state; native high-level targeting and exceptional weapon lifecycles remainXY. Bounded vertical collision impulses affect this same altitude integrator; no independent visual height copy is introduced.
policy.factorySpawns: FactorySpawnSafety wraps native building-held UnitPayloads at UnitCreateEvent and after world load. Native production costs/timing/upgrades and payload transport remain unchanged. At final dump, a straight forward extrusion checks the full physical hull, native movement-category solidity, terrain/buildings, XYZ unit overlap and configured barriers. Blocked exits remain unadded payloads and retry at most every six native ticks. Successful release places the whole body outside its producer and seeds canonical altitude before first entity update, removing only the native random birth impulse. No immunity or global collision grace; transported payload ownership is resolved at release. Low native-passable physical floor structures such as conveyors contribute to the output support height only within the existing unit step/reach bound; solid or too-tall neighbors still block release. This is tested through actual native factory production, payload movement and dump, including damage after birth.

acceptance.criterion: Pure tests cover convergence, altitude spread, climb clearance, descending, pause, frame-rate consistency, heading wrap and grounded tracking.
Native smoke verifies sidecars follow original units without changing map/unit native elevation, survive update and prune on death/world cleanup.

Pure tests hold yaw and level pitch/bank at zero horizontal velocity while altitude varies; native smoke invokes actual AI idle wobble and verifies it cannot create model circling, while commanded travel still turns the model and controllers remain untouched.

Native smoke executes actual isolated pinned PhysicsProcess with real native units: separated physical Z yields no passive XY motion, overlapping Z separates, disabling restores native 2D separation, and enabling discards pending legacy 2D correction. Tests restore original PhysicsWorld identity and keep velocity/AI references unchanged.
